title: feat(nm2t2y): M two-tick composition on two-axis opposite y-probes: reverse HOLD, face fails, composition HOLD
science: M two-tick exist-opposite on opposite y-probes: M(t)=M(t+1) at all four; reverse HOLD from M(A)={-e_1} vs M(B)={+e_1}. That HOLD is a direct read-back of the seed letters the member itself planted at tick 0 - the readout returns its own input.
